homeDescription: Your drives, cache activity and shortcuts at a glance.
homeAllConfigurations: Live totals across all cache configurations
homeNoConfiguration: Choose your drives in Cache settings
homeCacheHint: Your original files stay on the HDD. Manage cached games and folders in the Library, or change drives and capacity in Cache settings.
ssdOnly: SSD cache. No dedicated RAM tier.
welcomeText: Give your hard drive a faster place to read from. Keep your files where they belong, with precise control over your SSD space.
demoBanner: DESIGN PREVIEW · Example data. No disk operations or acceleration are active.
desktopRequired: Open the Windows desktop application to discover your real drives.
setupDescription: Choose an HDD, an SSD or NVMe, your cache size, and what to accelerate.
automaticHint: A recommendation that respects your free space.
customHint: Set the exact amount that works for you.
planHint: No storage has been changed. These checks must pass before activation.
driverUnavailableText: System-wide acceleration is not active in this development build. You can inspect your drives and the measured file-cache tests below Performance.
labCacheHint: Driver telemetry is from an unqualified disposable-VHD lab build. It does not qualify this build for use on real data drives. No application acceleration controls are enabled.
inflightMutations: Writes and storage operations in flight
noActiveCacheText: Select a source HDD and an SSD to prepare your acceleration settings.
telemetryHint: Charts appear when a supported driver reports real cache activity.
performanceDescription: Cache activity over time, with diagnostics and measured file-cache benchmarks.
unsupported: Not supported by the active backend
storageDescription: Your actual drives, capacities, and available space.
cacheStrategyHint: Source writes remain authoritative. No deferred write-back and no dedicated RAM cache.
settingsDescription: A quieter utility, made to fit the way you work.
reducedMotionHint: Keep transitions still and resource use quiet.
startWindowsHint: Available after the desktop installer is qualified.
buildStatusHint: UI and algorithm tests are separate from transparent storage qualification.
planValid: Configuration validated; activation is blocked until qualification.
qualificationRequired: Transparent caching is blocked until a signed driver passes disposable-volume and hardware qualification.
encryptionUnknown: Source encryption is unknown or enabled; elevated validation is required.
driverNotLoaded: The Super HDD driver is not loaded.
benchmarkScope: Controlled test on disposable files. These results do not mean that Windows applications or games are currently accelerated.
benchmarkMethod: Three rounds, queue depth 1, identical read trace and SHA-256 checks. Windows file-data caching bypassed on both HDD and SSD. Drive/controller caches remain enabled. Warm results apply to data already cached; first reads and sequential scans can be slower.
benchmarkNotActive: These are file-level test results. The transparent storage driver is not running; no system-wide acceleration is enabled.
benchmarkPending: Hardware measurements appear here after a controlled benchmark has completed.
runtimeReleasePending: The deployable driver package has not been signed and qualified yet.
runtimeKernelDriverUnavailable: The Windows storage cache driver is not loaded.
runtimeRestartRequired: Restart Windows once to load the storage filter, then continue. Your page file stays on its current drive.
runtimeNotInstalled: Install the qualified runtime package to continue.
runtimePackageChanged: The installed runtime differs from this release.
runtimePermissionsUnsafe: The runtime installation permissions need repair.
runtimeTestBuild: An isolated test driver is running.
runtimeOperationPending: The operation is still pending. Check the service status.
runtimeOperationFailed: The service operation failed. Check diagnostics.
runtimeSourceBusy: Close files and programs using the source drive, then try stopping the cache again.
nativeFileListUnavailable: A list of cached file names is not available.
runtimeServiceUnavailable: The service is running but its control connection is unavailable.
runtimeSessionFaulted: The cache needs recovery. Stop it before starting again.
cacheScopeHint: Use the whole HDD volume or choose specific game and program folders.
wholeVolumeHint: All eligible reads on the selected volume.
selectedOnlyHint: Keep the cache for the folders you choose.
appFolder: Game or program folder on the selected HDD
noSelectedFolders: Add at least one game or program folder to review this setup.
folderInvalid: Enter a full subfolder path on the selected HDD. Drive roots and relative paths are not accepted.
folderLimit: You can select up to 64 folders.
selectedScopeUnavailable: Selected-folder caching is not supported by the current engine. This setup cannot be started.
selectionDraftHint: Saved as preferences only. Folder existence has not been checked; this list does not show cached files.
cacheFileListUnavailable: The current driver does not report cached file names or live occupied bytes.
cacheEmpty: No cache session is running. There are no active cached copies to list.
cacheStateUnavailable: Cache contents are unavailable until the service reports its state.
clearCopiesHint: Clearing invalidates cached copies; the original HDD files are preserved.
folderScopeHint: Accelerates the selected folder at its usual path. Close the game before starting or stopping. Stop restores the original folder.
folderChooseOne: Choose one game or program folder for this version.
folderRuntimeUnavailable: The folder cache runtime is not ready on this computer.
folderRecoveryRequired: The folder needs restoration. Press Stop to recover its original path.
folderCurrentDevicesOnly: This local version supports the D HDD and M SSD.
folderCacheEmpty: No file data is currently resident in the cache.
diagnosticsDescription: Live cache status, activity and error counters.
diagnosticsFolderEngine: Selected-folder cache using the installed Dokan runtime.
diagnosticsConnected: Connected to the cache engine. Counters below come from its live telemetry.
diagnosticsUnavailable: No cache engine telemetry is available.
diagnosticsHostHint: Games use independent background hosts. Closing this window leaves their caches running.
diagnosticsManagementHint: Select games, inspect cached files and control each cache from the Library.
performanceHistoryHint: History is recorded while this window is visible and kept locally for up to 30 days. Unrecorded time stays blank.
performanceAverageHint: Rates are averages of recorded intervals; counters cover the selected period.
performanceNoHistory: No recorded activity for this period yet. Leave the app visible while using the cache to build its history.
performanceRecordingStopped: Live recording is paused or no cache is active. Previously recorded periods remain available.
performanceStorageFailed: History is available for this session, but could not be saved locally.
